body.name: endpoint selector and SCM certificates
body.construction: For inputs \(\gamma_L\in\Gamma_L\) and \(\gamma_U\in\Gamma_U\), set \(s_{L,x}(c)=\gamma_{L,cx}/p_c\) and \(s_{U,x}(c)=\gamma_{U,cx}/p_c\), then instantiate \(\sigma_s\), \(Z_s\), and \(\mathcal M_{H,s}\) by \(\mathrm{def:common\text{-}response\text{-}witness}\) and \(\mathrm{def:macro\text{-}scm}\).
